t: You're looking at Albert Court, a grade two listed mansion block in South Kensington, in the area known as Albertopolis. It sits on a plot to the south-east of the Royal Albert Hall, along Prince Consort Road. Beatrice de Pass, the wife of Sir Eliot Arthur de Pass, died here in 1939. She was born in 1866. The material says little more about her, but it places her in one of the grand mansion blocks beside the Albert Hall.
